Returns the code, the name, the status, the duration in minutes, and the age rating of each movie. Data from the web site of Cavea, cavea.ge.

tools.name: fuel_get_prices
tools.description: Returns the current fuel prices of Georgian fuel companies: the price in GEL of one unit of each product. tools.name: offers_search_offers

tools.description: Finds the postal codes of Georgian Post for an address, a street, a town, or a village of Georgia, by text in Georgian or English. Returns each matching address with its 4-digit postal code and its district. Georgian Post gives a postal code for each street in Tbilisi, Batumi, and Kutaisi only. For

tools.name: rates_get_commercial_rates
tools.description: Returns the current commercial exchange rates of Georgian banks: the prices in GEL at which a bank buys and sells one unit of a currency. Use it for the price of a currency at a bank today, or to compare banks. Ask for 1 to 10 currencies. buy: the price in GEL that the bank pays when you sell it one

tools.name: rates_get_official_rates
tools.description: Returns the official exchange rates of the lari that the National Bank of Georgia (NBG) sets, for one date. Use it for the rate of a currency today or on a past date, for a contract, an invoice, or a tax form. Each rate is the price in GEL of `quantity` units; `rate_per_unit` is the price of one uni

tools.name: rates_list_official_history
tools.description: Returns the official exchange rates of one currency over a period of up to 31 days, as set by the National Bank of Georgia (NBG). Use it for the movement of a currency over a week or a month. The answer holds one point for each set in force in the period, the set in force on the first day included.

tools.name: stats_get_cells
tools.description: Returns the figures of one table of Geostat for a selection: value codes, or the last values, for each dimension. A dimension with no selection takes every value. Selects at most 1000 cells. An unpublished figure is null. The title of the table names the unit. Data from Geostat.

tools.name: stats_get_inflation
tools.description: Returns the inflation of Georgia for one month, in percent: annual (to the same month of the previous year), monthly (to the previous month), the 12 month average, and core inflation. For the whole country, a city, and a price group. The default is the newest published month. Data from the consumer

tools.name: stats_get_table
tools.description: Returns the title and the dimensions of one table of Geostat, with the code and the text of each value. Read it before stats_get_cells. The values of a time dimension go from the oldest to the newest. A table has no unit field: the title names it. Data from Geostat.

tools.name: stats_search_tables
tools.description: Finds the tables of Geostat, the National Statistics Office of Georgia, whose title or folder holds every word of a text: for example prices, salaries, population, GDP, and trade. Returns the code, the title, the folder, and the update date of each table, the newest first. Then call stats_get_table

tools.name: transit_get_route
tools.description: Returns a route of the TTC with each direction: its headsign and its stops in order.

tools.name: transit_get_timetable
tools.description: Returns the planned departure times of one direction of a route of the TTC at one stop, on a date of the current week. A time of 24:00 or later is after midnight, on the next date.

tools.name: transit_list_arrivals
tools.description: Lists the next vehicles of the TTC at a stop: route number, kind, headsign, minutes from as_of, and the expected instant. live is true when the TTC tracks the vehicle; else the time comes from the timetable. With a route, lists the next vehicles of that route only.

tools.name: transit_list_nearby_stops
tools.description: Lists the stops of the TTC within a distance of a point in Tbilisi, nearest first, with the distance in metres. Use transit_search_places to get the coordinates of a place.

tools.name: transit_plan_trip
tools.description: Plans a trip by public transport of the TTC in Tbilisi between two points, given as coordinates. Returns up to 3 itineraries with each leg: walk or ride, route, stops, instants, distance in metres. Use transit_search_places to get coordinates.

tools.name: transit_search_places
tools.description: Finds places in Tbilisi (addresses, streets, buildings) by text, with their coordinates, for transit_plan_trip and transit_list_nearby_stops. Data from OpenStreetMap through the TTC.

tools.name: transit_search_routes
tools.description: Finds the routes of the TTC by number or by name. Kinds: bus, minibus, metro, cable_car. With no query, lists every route.

tools.name: transit_search_stops
tools.description: Finds the stops of the Tbilisi Transport Company (bus stops, metro stations, cable car stations) by name or stop code, in Georgian or English. Use the stop id of the result with transit_list_arrivals or transit_get_timetable.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "offers_search_offers" is 1610 chars, far longer than this server's median (296). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "stats_get_table" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cinema_get_seat_map, offers_get_offer, offers_search_offers, postal_search_codes · Private data: offers_search_offers · Public sink: postal_search_codes · Destructive: cinema_list_sessions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cinema_get_seat_map, offers_get_offer, offers_search_offers, postal_search_codes · Private data: offers_search_offers · Public sink: postal_search_codes · Destructive: cinema_list_sessions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
